alt: Cracked Tesla Cybertruck 'armor glass' window at the November 2019 unveiling event, with fracture lines radiating from the steel-ball impact point across the dark glass pane
story: On November 6, 2026, Elon Musk announced Tesla will end Cybertruck production in mid-2027 — the truck was designed with installed capacity for 250,000 units per year but has sold roughly 12% of that target, a failure that began at the 2019 unveiling when Musk's 'armor glass' window shattered live on stage during the demo.
why_funny: The truck built to withstand anything immediately couldn't survive a metal ball thrown by its own designer, and seven years later it also couldn't survive the market.
